name: 3 Ninjas Kick Back
summary:
3 Ninjas Kick Back is a beat 'em up platform game for the Sega Genesis, Super Nintendo Entertainment System. It was released in 1994 and was developed by Malibu Interactive. The Genesis version was published by Psygnosis while the SNES. The Sega CD version was released exclusively in a bundle pack with another game Hook and was not released separately.

The game is based on the film of the same name.

name: 3-nen B-Gumi Kinpachi-sensei: Densetsu no Kyoudan ni Tate!
3ndl3zz: Base Defense
summary: A simple militant styled, tower defense game, there is only one map, and thus a limited space for towers.

name: 3 Ninjas Kick Back
summary:
3 Ninjas Kick Back / Hook, for lack of a better name, is a compilation for the Sega Mega-CD released exclusively in North America. It contains CD versions of the Sega Mega Drive games 3 Ninjas Kick Back and Hook.

3 Ninjas Kick Back was never released as a stand-alone game for the Mega-CD. Hook is presumed to be identical to its regular Mega-CD counterpart.

name: 3 Nights of Terror
summary: 3 Nights of Terror lets you dive into the Nightmare-driven Dreams of Police Officer Scott Harris, who suffers from an extreme form of Parasomnia. Guide him through his horrifying dreams and survive the Nightmares to ensure he wakes up in the morning.
